question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Mithya's remarkable __generosity__ extended to everyone she knew.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"generosity"** means the quality of being kind and generous. (उदारता)
 
 
• **Example: **Her generosity towards the underprivileged is truly commendable.
 
 
 
• **"Selfishness"** refers to the quality of being concerned excessively or exclusively with oneself, seeking or concentrating on one's own advantage, pleasure, or well-being without regard for others. (स्वार्थ)
 
 
• **Example: **His selfishness was evident when he refused to help his friends in need.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'generosity'** is **'selfishness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Perfection** (पूर्णता): The state of being perfect or free from flaws.
 
 
• **Example: **She strives for perfection in everything she does.
 
 
 
• **Cowardice** (कायरता): Lack of bravery.
 
 
• **Example: **His cowardice was revealed when he fled from the scene of the accident.
 
 
 
• **Awkwardness** (बेढंगापन): The quality of being clumsy or socially uncomfortable.
 
 
• **Example: **There was an awkwardness in the room after his inappropriate comment.
